YOUR DESIGNS STAY YOURS

Privacy policy

Last updated: October 3, 2026

The free Pumpkin Studio designer processes artwork, text, settings, and printable models on your device. The iOS app bundles its designer, fonts, and geometry engine and works offline. It does not use accounts, advertising, analytics, tracking, or a developer-operated artwork upload service.

Artwork and designs

You choose the images or SVG files you import. The app processes those files locally; it does not upload them to the developer. The current design and imported artwork remain in memory until the designer is reset or closed.

Exported files

On iOS, exports are saved in Files → On My iPhone/iPad → Pumpkin Studio → Exports. They remain there even if you cancel sharing and can be deleted using Files. Exported ZIPs include the STL models, dimensions, and printing settings. Device backups follow your Apple settings. If you use AirDrop, Save to Files, or another destination in the share sheet, that transfer follows the settings and privacy practices of the service or app you choose.

Website and support

Free web Batch Export generates selected built-in faces and sizes locally on your device. No license, payment, activation, artwork, or batch selections are sent to a batch service. Batch Export is not included in the native iOS interface.

The web version is hosted by GitHub Pages. GitHub may process ordinary hosting request data, such as your IP address, under its privacy statement. If you follow an external support link or submit a GitHub issue, GitHub handles that interaction under its own policy. Please avoid posting personal information or private artwork in public issues.

Contact

For privacy questions or app support, use the Pumpkin Studio issue tracker.
